mode: live API advisory source review; no customer validation

manufactured_completion.instructions: Does the new history UI manufacture completion from a queued response or a successful action call instead of reading server state?

cross_scope_display.instructions: Can a mismatched owner/project/document record pass the new parser and be displayed as a valid workflow?

draft_launch_overclaim.instructions: Does this new history view claim saved text or a completed preparation workflow proves live campaign launch?

missing_ui_contract.instructions: Select the most significant concrete remaining defect in this bounded UI implementation, if the supplied source establishes one.

criteria.optimistic_completion: Local action success changes displayed completion without server evidence.
criteria.cross_scope: Wrong owner or project records pass the boundary.
criteria.draft_launch: Saved outputs are labelled as an actual launched campaign.
criteria.none: None of these concrete defects is established by the source.
